item.title: LMArena
item.description: LMArena began as the LMSYS Chatbot Arena, a research project from UC Berkeley researchers. You enter a prompt, get answers from two anonymous models, and vote for the one you prefer, and only then are the model names revealed. Votes from a very large number of people are converted into ratings, using a statistical method similar to chess Elo scores, which produces a ranking that reflects real preferences instead of fixed test questions.

item.title: OpenTools
item.description:
OpenTools is a catalog for finding AI products. Visitors search or filter by what they want to do, see short descriptions and pricing information, and follow links to the tools. Beyond products, the site lists models and Model Context Protocol servers, which are useful to developers building agents.

Guides and news help readers understand what is new and how to use tools well. Builders can submit their products for listing, which is how most directories grow.
